subject: Termized prepayment savings proposal for Stratos AI
messages:

Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@stratos.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Termized prepayment savings proposal for Stratos AI

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for a great conversation last week. Attached is a concise proposal that models two prepay structures we discussed: a 2-year annual prepay and a 3-year staged prepay. High-level: the 3-year term provides the deepest blended unit discount (illustrated in the attached PDF) while keeping Redwood’s support and SLA commitments intact.

Key bullets:
- 2-year option: 15% effective discount with annual prepayment.
- 3-year option: 19% effective discount with tiered staging (recommended for predictable unit economics).
- Suggested ramp: majority of consumption credited in year 1 to match your product launch cadence; optional split schedules available.
- SLA credit cap and standard support plan included; custom SLAs can be added for enterprise support.

Can you confirm whether the staged billing cadence we outlined (50% / 30% / 20%) maps to your finance needs? If yes, I’ll route this to our finance team for an approval pass and send a DocuSign link once we land on numbers.

Attachments: Redwood_3yr_offer_Stratos.pdf (offer summary), SOW_Stratos_2026_v2.docx (draft SOW)

Thanks,
Grace

From: Elena Martinez <elena.m@stratos.ai>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Termized prepayment savings proposal for Stratos AI

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the proposal. A few clarifying items from procurement:
- We prefer a front-loaded schedule given our expected ramp: 50% year 1 / 25% year 2 / 25% year 3.
- Can Redwood offer an additional 5–7% concession on top of the 3-year blended price if we commit to a 36-month minimum and agree to annual invoicing (we can do annual prepay, not monthly)?
- We need to see the SLA credit mechanics in writing (monthly availability thresholds, credit caps).
- Any flexibility on payment split (we may need the first payment as a single invoice for budget approval).

If you can share an updated counter with specific dollar examples and a DocuSign-ready contract by EOD Friday, we can accelerate internal sign-off.

Thanks,
Elena

elena.m@stratos.ai

Subject: FWD: Termized prepayment savings proposal for Stratos AI — internal approval request

Aditya / Vivek —

Forwarding Stratos' reply. They want a front-loaded 50/25/25 split and are asking for an additional 5–7% concession on top of the 3-year blended price if Redwood will accept annual prepay. They also want SLA mechanics spelled out and a single first invoice.

My suggested commercial counter (to put through finance):
- 3-year term, effective blended discount 18% (vs. list), with an authorized exception up to 19% if we accept the 50/25/25 staging and they commit to annual prepay.
- Payment terms: Year 1 invoice up front for 60% of year 1 list (to reduce cashflow risk for Redwood), remaining Year1 balance invoiced at month 6; Year2/Year3 billed annually per agreed schedule. (This is adjustable; they asked for single first invoice — we can accommodate.)
- SLA: Standard SLA credits apply, cap at 5% of annual invoice; we can offer a one-time onboarding SLA credit up to 10% tied to acceptance criteria in SOW.

If approved I’ll prepare a revised offer PDF and route the amendment for DocuSign. Need a quick decision to meet their EOD Friday ask.

Thanks,
Grace

Grace —

Reviewed. Finance is comfortable authorizing the commercial counter with the following guardrails:
- Authorized discount up to 19% effective for a signed 36-month commitment (deal_id RDW-STR-2026-042).

- SLA credit cap confirmed at 5% of annual invoice; onboarding credit (one-time) up to 10% is OK if SOW acceptance criteria are objective.

Please update the offer PDF and SOW. Finance will generate the amendment and prepare the DocuSign envelope; notify procurement link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890 for next steps.
